verdict.rationale: Quo documents sharing one business number across a team and per-number inboxes that hold message history, so texts to a shared number landing in a team-visible inbox is supported at a basic level. Nothing shows which teammate sent a given reply. missing for 10: documented per-message attribution of who replied in the shared inbox, explicit shared-inbox workflow docs (assignment, collision avoidance), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, texts to the business number land in a shared inbox where the team sees who replied

citations.quote: Share one number and stay aligned with your team
Pull message history from any Quo inbox, filter by contact, date, or topic, or list all your inboxes to see which numbers are available.
Pull messages and call activity from any Quo inbox and ask for a summary.
